name: openbank-ng
description: Nigerian banking and wallet infrastructure foundation.

repository.url: Buyer delivery repository assigned during handoff

scripts.build: npm run build -w @openbank-ng/shared && npm run build -w @openbank-ng/api && npm run build -w @openbank-ng/customer-web && npm run build -w @openbank-ng/admin-web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @openbank-ng/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @openbank-ng/shared && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
